description: Renter only, lease must be ACTIVE: returns everything you need to control the body — the control WebSocket URL, granted permissions, each command's schema, offered feeds and how to authenticate the socket: /supervisory for a supervisory lease, /teleop (plus its rate and dead-man limits) for a teleop lease. Commands, teleop frames and read_feed go over that WebSocket, not MCP.
name: open_control_session
title: Open a robot control session
